-- опишите текст решения этих карт. Укажите, имеют ли эти карты отсутствующие или ухудшенные свойства и значения.

SELECT 
    c.name AS CardName,
    r.text AS RulingText,
    CASE 
        WHEN c.artist = 'Stephen Daniel' THEN 'Yes'
        ELSE 'No'
    END AS HasCorrectArtist,
    CASE 
        WHEN c.flavortext IS NULL OR TRIM(c.flavortext) = '' THEN 'Missing'
        ELSE 'Present'
    END AS FlavorTextStatus,
    CASE 
        WHEN c.text IS NULL OR TRIM(c.text) = '' THEN 'Missing'
        ELSE 'Present'
    END AS TextStatus
FROM 
    cards c
JOIN 
    rulings r ON c.uuid = r.uuid
WHERE 
    c.artist LIKE '%Stephen Daniel%';

question: For all the set of cards that has Japanese translation, what is the percentage of them are only available in non-foil?

    FROM cards c
    JOIN set_translations st ON c.setcode = st.setcode

non_foil_only_cards AS (
